nodes.label: Owned Process
nodes.rationale: Live language-server sessions are Owned Processes so Workspace Close and Application Quit tear them down through Process Launch.

nodes.label: user/config/oil.yaml
nodes.rationale: Most oil chords come from user/config/oil.yaml defaults rather than package keybindings so they can be rebound without rebuilding.

nodes.label: Picker Preview Layout
nodes.rationale: Preview pickers place a file or content preview beside the list, filling available height up to REPOSITORY_FILE_PREVIEW_MAX_LINES (256).

nodes.label: Terminal Shell Config
nodes.rationale: The shell program and args come from user/config/ui.yaml, with platform defaults if unset.

nodes.label: Undo Tree Picker
nodes.rationale: Undo history is opened as a navigable picker so jumps can follow the undo tree rather than only linear undo steps.

nodes.label: Space Leader Map
nodes.rationale: The default Space leader map is how modal editing reaches workspace, git, oil, terminal, ACP, and other plugins.

nodes.label: Workspace Plugin
nodes.rationale: Closing a workspace tears down Owned Processes tagged to that workspace (terminals, jobs, language tooling) via Process Launch and Process Registry.

nodes.label: + Create New
nodes.rationale: The + prefix matches the worktree dashboard row + new worktree; git init runs only for a new directory line with a trailing slash, not for a file, and closing the oil buffer cancels the pending create.
